component_rows.scope_summary: Artifact identity bar naming artifact class, canonical source, and parser/schema state at the top of every structured or media-like compare surface
component_rows.canonical_source_disclosure: Names the artifact class and the canonical source of truth (working-tree path, generated-from origin, or imported snapshot) and never presents an adjunct capture as the source
component_rows.compare_write_back_safety: Identity bar is read-only and never offers write-back; it only labels whether the underlying artifact is compare-only or writable
component_rows.render_trust_disclosure: States whether the identity was parsed from a trusted structured header or inferred, so an inferred class is never shown as confirmed
component_rows.generated_from_relation: When the artifact is generated it names the generating source of truth rather than treating the generated file as authoritative

component_rows.scope_summary: Diff-mode switcher exposing the available structured diff modes (structured, cell-aware, rendered, raw) and the active mode without silently collapsing to raw
component_rows.canonical_source_disclosure: Names the canonical artifact being diffed and which side is base versus compare so the mode never obscures what is compared
component_rows.compare_write_back_safety: Switching modes is a view-only operation that never writes back; it only changes how the compare is rendered
component_rows.render_trust_disclosure: Labels each mode's render trust so a rendered mode is marked untrusted rather than presented as an authoritative structured diff
component_rows.generated_from_relation: When one side is a generated artifact the switcher marks it generated so a diff is never read as a hand-authored change

component_rows.scope_summary: Structure row showing one structured path (cell, node, key, or symbol) and its change class so nested structure is never flattened into opaque line noise
component_rows.canonical_source_disclosure: Names the structured path against its canonical artifact so a row maps back to a real location rather than a synthetic index
component_rows.compare_write_back_safety: Structure rows are read-only anchors; selecting one navigates without mutating the artifact
component_rows.render_trust_disclosure: Marks whether the structure was parsed faithfully or partially so a partial parse is never presented as complete structure
component_rows.generated_from_relation: When a structure row belongs to a generated artifact it inherits the generated-from marker from the identity bar rather than hiding it

component_rows.scope_summary: Merge-decision row picking base, ours, or theirs for one structured conflict with the resulting write-back safety always explicit
component_rows.canonical_source_disclosure: Names the conflicting structured path and the base/ours/theirs lineage so a decision is never applied to an ambiguous target
component_rows.compare_write_back_safety: The row states whether resolving writes back to a writable artifact or stays compare-only, and a compare-only artifact is never silently promoted to writable
component_rows.render_trust_disclosure: Marks whether the merged preview is a trusted structured merge or a raw fallback so an untrusted merge is never applied blindly
component_rows.generated_from_relation: When a side is generated the row surfaces the generated-from relation so a merge decision never overwrites a regenerable artifact by hand

component_rows.scope_summary: Generated-artifact notice naming the generating source of truth and regeneration path so a generated file is never edited as if it were authoritative
component_rows.canonical_source_disclosure: Names the generated-from source of truth and marks the artifact non-authoritative, never presenting the generated output as the canonical source
component_rows.compare_write_back_safety: Marks the artifact regenerate-only so manual write-back is blocked in favor of regenerating from source
component_rows.render_trust_disclosure: States whether the generation lineage was verified fresh or is stale so a stale generated artifact is labeled rather than trusted
component_rows.generated_from_relation: This is the primary carrier of the generated-from relation and never hides it behind generic file chrome

component_rows.scope_summary: Rendered compare viewer showing two structured or media-like artifacts side by side with the render-trust class always explicit
component_rows.canonical_source_disclosure: Names both compared artifacts and their canonical sources so a rendered comparison is anchored to real inputs
component_rows.compare_write_back_safety: The viewer is strictly compare-only and never writes back to either rendered artifact
component_rows.render_trust_disclosure: This is the primary carrier of render-trust class; an untrusted render is labeled untrusted and offers an export-safe raw fallback
component_rows.generated_from_relation: When a rendered side is generated the viewer surfaces the generated-from relation so a render is never mistaken for the source of truth

component_rows.scope_summary: Media-metadata rail exposing dimensions, encoding, and provenance metadata for media-like artifacts so metadata visibility is never dropped from a preview
component_rows.canonical_source_disclosure: Names the media artifact and its canonical source, distinguishing captured metadata from inferred metadata
component_rows.compare_write_back_safety: The rail is read-only and never writes back to the media artifact or its metadata
component_rows.render_trust_disclosure: Marks whether metadata was extracted from a trusted decoder or is unavailable so missing metadata is shown as missing rather than blank
component_rows.generated_from_relation: When media is generated (a rendered snapshot or export) the rail names the generated-from relation rather than treating it as an original capture

component_rows.scope_summary: Redaction or trust badge set naming redaction, export, and safe-preview posture so a redacted or untrusted artifact is never presented as fully visible or fully trusted
component_rows.canonical_source_disclosure: Names the artifact and its redaction/trust class so the badge maps to a real posture rather than a decorative label
component_rows.compare_write_back_safety: The badge set is read-only; it annotates safety and never itself mutates the artifact
component_rows.render_trust_disclosure: This is the primary carrier of trust/safe-preview class and marks an untrusted preview so it is never opened as trusted
component_rows.generated_from_relation: When a badge covers a generated artifact it preserves the generated-from marker so trust posture and lineage stay together

component_rows.scope_summary: Compare-summary card rolling up an artifact comparison (added/removed/changed structure, render trust, safety) without flattening distinct classes into a single verdict
component_rows.canonical_source_disclosure: Names the compared artifacts and their canonical sources so the summary is attributable to real inputs
component_rows.compare_write_back_safety: The card summarizes safety but is read-only and never itself writes back or promotes a compare-only artifact
component_rows.render_trust_disclosure: Rolls up per-side render trust so an untrusted render is visible in the summary rather than averaged away
component_rows.generated_from_relation: Surfaces when either side is generated so a summary never hides that a change is regenerable rather than hand-authored
